SHANGHAI, 13th November 1931.

Sir,

I should be greatly obliged if you could in-
form me regarding the present whereabouts of Georges
Grigorieff , a musician formerly employed by the
restaurant "Valencia" at No.80 Szechuen Road, about
whom Mr. van den Berg had occasion to write to you
before (No.1893 of 3rd June).

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

R.G.Alers,Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

S2,
For attention
please. [Signature]

Date June 26, 1931
26 - 6 - 31.

Subject (in full) G. Grigorieff.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature] OI.

With reference to the attached letter of
June 3, 1931 from the Netherlands Consulate General, concerning
one G. Grigorieff, enquiries show that this individual is, in
all probability, identical to Georgy Isaevitch Grigorieff,
aged about 34 years, married, musician, residing at 115 Joffre
Terrace and at the present time employed at the "Valencia Restau-
rant," No. 84 Szechuen Road. He is reported to have recently
arrived in Shanghai from Japan after having visited India and
Indonesia.

Enquiries among Russian musicians employed
in local cabarets have, so far, failed to elicit any information
as to the whereabouts or identity of P.F. Grigorieff.

Neither of the above mentioned persons are
registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 6-A Hongkong
Road or at the office of the Russian National Community, 876
Avenue Joffre. It is, however, possible that they may be
registered as emigrants with the Public Safety Bureau, Nantao.

Attached herewith are two copies of a photo
of G.I. Grigorieff.

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch,

S2,
[Handwritten note:] Please communicate contents of
above report verbally to Netherlands Consul.
DS. Prokofiev.
[Handwritten note:] 7 ov. SB.
[Handwritten note:] SMR. 26/6

File
[Signature]

事由（全称）G. 格里戈里耶夫。

制作人：D.S. 普罗科菲耶夫。转呈人 [签名] OI.

关于随附的1931年6月3日荷兰总领事馆来函，涉及一名 G. 格里戈里耶夫，经查，此人极可能与格奥尔基·伊萨耶维奇·格里戈里耶夫 (Georgy Isaevitch Grigorieff) 为同一人，年龄约34岁，已婚，乐师，居住于茹费理台115号，目前受雇于四川路84号“瓦伦西亚餐厅” (Valencia Restaurant)。据报他近期在访问印度和印度尼西亚后，从日本抵达上海。

迄今向在当地歌舞厅受雇的俄国乐师查询，未能获得有关 P.F. 格里戈里耶夫下落或身份的任何信息。

上述两人均未在香港路6-A号的俄国侨民委员会或茹费理路876号的俄国国民公会办事处登记。不过，他们有可能已在南市公安局以侨民身份登记。

随函附上 G.I. 格里戈里耶夫照片两张。

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
D. S.

特务股主管警官，

S2,
[手写笔记:] 请将上述报告内容口头告知荷兰领事。
DS. 普罗科菲耶夫。
[手写笔记:] 7 ov. SB.
[手写笔记:] SMR. 26/6

归档
[签名]

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 1993.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. REGISTRY
No. S. D. 121.
date 4 - 6 - 31.

SHANGHAI, 3rd June 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I am desirous to
get into touch with a certain G.Grigorieff, a musician, who
stayed at the Sport Hotel in Soerabaia about April 1930
and appears to reside at the present time at Shanghai.

I know of a certain P.P.Grigorieff who belonged to
the troupe engaged in January 1930 at the Canidrome and
most probably was a Soviet citizen.

It is possible however that G. and P.P.Grigorieff
are one and the same person and I would be much obliged to
receive further information, in case you could supply me
therewith.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

R.C.Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

（左侧批注：* Sir, File attached. [Signature]）
（右下批注：Sg, For attention please [Signature] 4:6:31）

上海，1931年6月3日。

先生：

谨此通知，本人希望与一位名为 G. 格里戈里耶夫的乐师取得联系，他约于1930年4月居住在泗水 (Soerabaia) 的运动酒店 (Sport Hotel)，目前似乎居住在上海。

本人知悉有一位 P.P. 格里戈里耶夫，属于1930年1月在跑狗场 (Canidrome) 受聘的剧团，极可能是苏联公民。

然而，G. 和 P.P. 格里戈里耶夫有可能是同一人，如蒙提供进一步资料，不胜感激。

此致
敬礼
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
华务秘书。

R.C. 阿勒斯 先生，
副巡官，
刑事及特务处，
上海。

（左侧批注：* 先生，附件已归档。[签名]）

SHANGHAI, 19th March 1929 .

Sir,

I have the honour to enclose herewith applications
for a vise to Netherlands East Indies for Mr. and Mrs. S.
Chambers, Mr. D. A. Koletz, Mr. and Mrs. S. Grigorieff, Mr. S. L.
Liport and his mother Mrs. Liport.

The men are all musicians and intend to go to Soera-
baia on contract.

I would be much obliged for any information as to
politics or morals , which you may have with regard to
these persons.

I might add that Messrs. Chambers and Koletz obtained
vise's for admission to the Netherlands East Indies in
August 1925.

It would be appreciated if the application forms
could be returned with your answer.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
